about: A test fixture for tests/vm-core.test.mjs only (design 2.1's test: a record of 1499..1500 for c03-p03). It is not a periods file of the book: S1 commits none, and bibliotheca/data/periods/ is S4's. The paragraph states no year: 1499..1500 is inferred from the events it names (Louis XII takes and loses Milan, 1499 to 1500); its "second time" reaches the losses of 1512 to 1513.
